scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:vscode
scripts.test: pnpm run support:validate && pnpm run build && vitest run --project unit --project cli --project db-sqlite
scripts.typecheck:packages: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime-floor.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:packages && pnpm --dir extensions/vscode exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:db: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-postgres --project db-mysql --project db-mariadb --project db-sqlite --project db-oracle --project db-mssql
scripts.test:db:bun-sql: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-bun-sql
scripts.test:db:postgres: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-postgres
scripts.test:db:mysql: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-mysql
scripts.test:db:mariadb: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-mariadb
scripts.test:capabilities: pnpm run support:validate && vitest run tests/db/*/capabilities.test.ts
scripts.test:bulk: vitest run pv16-bulk pv16-native-bulk pv16-oracle pv16-mariadb pv16-sqlite-cloud tests/db
scripts.benchmark:release-smoke: pnpm run benchmark:bulk-execution && pnpm run benchmark:value-fidelity:smoke
scripts.test:db:oracle: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-oracle
scripts.test:db:mssql: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-mssql
scripts.test:db:sqlite: pnpm run build && vitest run --project db-sqlite
scripts.test:consumer: pnpm run build && vitest run --project consumer && pnpm run pack:check && pnpm run test:consumer:gates
scripts.test:all: pnpm run support:validate && pnpm run docs:translations && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && vitest run && pnpm run test:browser && pnpm run test:d1 && pnpm run test:vscode && pnpm run pack:check && pnpm run test:consumer:gates

scripts.test:agent-tooling: pnpm run build && vitest run --project unit --project cli tests/tooling.test.ts tests/tooling-workspace.test.ts tests/language-server.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts
scripts.test:streaming: vitest run pv15-runtime pv15-pg-mysql pv15-oracle-mssql pv15-sqlite tests/db
scripts.test:routines: vitest run pv15-contracts pv15-runtime pv15-pg-mysql pv15-oracle-mssql pv15-sqlite tests/db
